description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Kinesis::StreamConsumer. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-kinesis.git

Tag.description: An arbitrary set of tags (key-value pairs) to associate with the Kinesis consumer.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 255 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Tag.title: AWSKinesisStreamConsumerTagDefinition

ConsumerName.description: The name of the Kinesis Stream Consumer. For a given Kinesis data stream, each consumer must have a unique name. However, consumer names don't have to be unique across data streams.

StreamARN.description: The Amazon resource name (ARN) of the Kinesis data stream that you want to register the consumer with.

Tags.description: An arbitrary set of tags (key–value pairs) to associate with the Kinesis consumer.

title: AWSKinesisStreamConsumerProperties
